default.text: Hides and teeth go to Master Hollis, not me. I only sort. And count. I counted right today. I checked twice.

marks.text: Weights, grades, and the stamps. Every forge in the March strikes its own mark on its iron. Master Hollis knows them all by heart. I know eleven.

eleven.text: East Watch is a tower. Saltmere is three waves. The King's is a crown, and you don't handle crown iron unless you want questions. The rest I get wrong when he watches.

worried.text: If I grade a hide wrong, it comes out of his purse, not mine. He never says so. That's worse.

options.text: Everyone gets it wrong at first. You'll learn.

worried_kind.text: That's what Mira says. Master Hollis says 'again'. I think they mean the same thing.

worried_plain.text: Three. Yes. I can do three.

worried_hard.text: ...Yes. Sorry. I'll get back to the pile.
